noun_definition: Profile refers to the user account settings section in the Expensify app where users can modify their display name.
Save button refers to the interface element that allows users to commit changes made to their display name in the profile settings, which is currently non-functional in offline mode.
display name page refers to the section within the Expensify app where users can modify their profile's display name settings.
Offline mode refers to the state in which the New Expensify app is not connected to the internet, preventing the user from saving changes made to their profile.
